title: Nibbles

title: Alzheimer's Screening Model
description: A machine learning model built to catch early signs of Alzheimer's before symptoms are obvious.

description: Exploratory analysis of disease data, from raw numbers to the patterns worth acting on.

title: Shape Decomposer
